description: A stalwart protector forged in the iron quarries of Thornhaven, who stands as an immovable wall between danger and the innocent. Their oak-and-steel shield bears the old forest runes of protection.
icon_hint: heavy iron tower shield with golden trim and protection rune
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy defender class. Heavy iron-riveted border with oak plank corners and gold nail heads. Dark stone wall center with faint green moss veins. Small golden shield rune etched at bottom center. Color palette: iron grey, deep forest green, warm gold accents. No characters, no text.
